mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications ( job_id, applicant_name, email, phone, cover_letter ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{applicantName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{coverLetter} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.job_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, a.phone, a.cover_letter, a.status, j.title AS job_title, j.company_name, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM applications a INNER JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.job_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, a.phone, a.cover_letter, a.status, j.title AS job_title, j.company_name, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM applications a INNER JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.job_id, a.applicant_name, a.email, a.phone, a.cover_letter, a.status, j.title AS job_title, j.company_name, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM applications a INNER JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
